title: Finding an Oblique (Slant) Asymptote
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the oblique asymptote of f(x) = (2x^2 + 3x - 1) / (x + 1) using polynomial long division.

steps.title: Perform Polynomial Long Division
steps.explanation: Divide (2x^2 + 3x - 1) by (x + 1): quotient is 2x + 1 with remainder -2.
steps.why: Long division separates the linear asymptote from the decaying remainder.

steps.title: Evaluate Remainder Limit at Infinity
steps.explanation: The vertical distance between the curve and the line 2x + 1 approaches zero as |x| -> oo.
steps.why: By definition, y = mx + b is an oblique asymptote if lim [f(x) - (mx + b)] = 0.
